title: Up And Up
description: In this side scroller parkour game, player need to be careful of different traps like fire, ice spikes, enemy balls and other traps. When player find the exit door and exit from there, level will be complete. Character has too many abilities like crouching, double jumping. Game has a health system, when player hit by a enemy ball, fire or ice spike, it will drop player's health.
description_short: An indie 2.5D parkour game. Make parkour in levels and find the exit!
